immediate_ask.description: Choose whether the workshop will be remote or in person.

overview.objective: Run a useful 90-minute session that makes first-week onboarding less confusing.
overview.user_need: New team members cannot always tell which systems and people to contact during their first week.
overview.today: Onboarding material is scattered across several documents.
overview.plain_language_solution: Test a short workshop, give everyone one clear checklist, and collect actionable feedback.
overview.why_now: The next intake of team members is approaching.

plan_now.current_agreed_plan: Prepare the agenda and checklist first. A remote vs. in-person format is not yet decided. Pilot the workshop, collect feedback, then revise the checklist.

visual_examples.title: Agenda sketch
visual_examples.description: 90 minutes: orientation, hands-on walkthrough, Q&A, retrospective.

user_journey.action: Send a session invitation and a one-page outline
user_journey.outcome: The workshop starts with shared expectations

user_journey.response: The coordinator answers real first-week questions
user_journey.outcome: Participant can perform core first-week tasks

user_journey.action: Collect feedback and revise the checklist

edge_cases.expected_behavior: Share the checklist and offer a short asynchronous question period.

success_measures.metric: Participants can complete at least three first-week tasks

assumptions.statement: The first-week tasks are representative of common onboarding problems

questions.question: Should we hold the pilot remotely or in person?
questions.why_it_matters: The format affects attendance, facilitation, and equipment.
questions.what_we_get: A format we can organize and communicate clearly.
questions.if_we_skip_it: Invitations and room arrangements remain blocked.

questions.question: How should we collect workshop feedback?
questions.why_it_matters: We need repeatable information for improvement.
questions.note: Conversation quality matters more than survey volume in the pilot.

defaults.question: How long should the pilot take?

direct_decisions.statement: Do not record identifiable participant discussions
direct_decisions.rationale: Encourage candid feedback in the pilot

out_this_round.description: Full redesign of the company onboarding program
out_this_round.reason: The pilot only tests the first-week workshop

phases.title: Draft agenda and checklist
phases.done_when: Agenda and checklist reviewed by a new joiner

phases.title: Run retrospective and revise checklist
phases.done_when: Top three issues reviewed and a new checklist version published

scenarios: Handle a question without a known owner
acceptance_criteria: Participants can identify where to ask for help
Feedback yields at least one concrete improvement

where_it_ships.rollout_strategy: Publish checklist to all new joiners
where_it_ships.rollback: Return to the existing checklist if the pilot introduces confusion

how_it_is_built.approach: Coordinator drafts materials, a new joiner reviews, then the group pilots.
quality_gates: Checklist is understandable without live explanation
handoffs: Coordinator to team lead for sign-off

events.summary: Asked for a guided first-week walkthrough.
events.original_quote: I don't know where to start when I get a new request.

events.summary: Selected a live retrospective rather than a survey.
events.original_quote: We need to hear where people are actually getting stuck.

versions.change_summary: First outline and first-week problem recorded
Feedback approach decided; delivery plan and dependencies added
